apparatus.note: The original margin records “Gr. Judas,” “Gr. bondservant,” and “Or, Jacob.” These remain source-specific name and rendering notes, not changed Scripture text.
The original 1901 printing preserves the account of Michael the archangel disputing over the body of Moses. Historical marginal notes remain in the scanned page.

Printed margin: “The Gr. text in this passage [And . . . fire] is somewhat uncertain.” Other possible readings are noted in print. Do not suppress this uncertainty or substitute a different modern reading.
The historical conclusion and doxology are retained; the printed margin includes translation and Greek-form notes.

scope_note: Selected major original 1901 marginal notes, supplemented by all original scanned printed apparatus and byte-preserved original digital USX notes; not a modern textual-critical reconstruction.
